verdict.rationale: Sketch offers a documented public JavaScript API, plugin ecosystem (skpm), a CLI (sketchtool), URL scheme, and an MCP server for AI-client integration, giving strong programmatic/agentic access. However, there's no evidence of a REST/HTTP API or OpenAPI spec (probe explicitly found 404s for openapi/swagger endpoints), which limits true 'drive via documented public API' for headless/server automation beyond plugins and MCP. missing for 10: a documented REST/OpenAPI-style public API, independent hands-on corroboration of API robustness, evidence of API rate limits/versioning guarantees for third-party server integrations.
